format: Graphdeco 3D Gaussian Splat PLY for SuperSplat
source_relation: Same dataset, sweep, configuration and seed as the previously exported 2D PNG, but from a later checkpoint regeneration run; not the exact original training run.
scale_activation: 0.05 + 2.95 * sigmoid(raw_scale), then divide by position normalization distance
caveat: SuperSplat uses standard alpha compositing, which differs from the native ULGSplat ultrasound renderer and can change visual appearance.
